baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired acts of saying and the deictic identification of a brother.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first speech act holds identity as an interrogative hypothesis; the reply makes that identity public and immediately places it inside a kin relation.

activation_trace.role: Conjectural force in interrogative saying keeps the first identification provisional.
Audible utterance converts the hypothesis into public self-naming through the answer.
Literal kinship makes the disclosure relational rather than a recovery of a proper name alone.

changed_reading.before: The exchange simply confirms that the official is Joseph and identifies the man beside him.
changed_reading.after: Recognition is staged as movement from voiced conjecture to voiced self-naming, with brotherhood restoring the disclosed identity to a relationship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence linking guarding, patience, divine non-loss, reward, and beneficent action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guarding establishes a protective discipline, patience sustains it under pressure, and the denial of loss guarantees that this endurance can mature into effective good rather than mere survival.

activation_trace.role: Putting oneself within protection supplies the active self-guarding at the condition's first stage.
Restraint from panic supplies persistence through the condition's second stage.
Disappearance or forfeiture names the outcome explicitly denied to sustained good.
Return for work gives the preserved consequence a labor-and-recompense structure.
Beneficent and well-made action extends the mechanism beyond private endurance into enacted good.

changed_reading.before: Piety and patience receive a divine reward.
changed_reading.after: Protective self-discipline and sustained restraint form a causal practice that keeps beneficent action alive, while divine non-loss secures its consequence against disappearance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Divine favor toward the two brothers followed by the assurance that reward is not lost.
baseline_models.mechanism: Favor can carry both benefaction and release without price; beside the restored brother-bond and the fracture-repair branch of reward, it permits a second reading in which grace liberates and rebinds rather than merely elevates.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal of benefaction supplies the direct sense of divine favor.
Release without compensation adds an unbought-liberation image to that favor.
The tether image turns brotherhood into a bond that can be fastened again.
Setting a break that healed crookedly contributes a cautious repair image to preserved reward.

changed_reading.before: God bestowed favor on Joseph and his brother.
changed_reading.after: A live secondary reading hears the favor as unpriced release that reties a damaged kin bond, with non-lost reward shading into repair rather than status alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: An imposed theft-story is attributed, held inside Joseph, and explicitly not displayed; the focus exchange reverses that sequence by letting him author and voice his own identity.

activation_trace.role: Attribution of theft supplies the externally imposed account attached to Joseph's family.
Hiding something inwardly supplies the first movement of controlled concealment.
The mind's inward content locates the withheld response before it is voiced.
Appearance and emergence name the disclosure that is initially refused.
The paired spoken acts provide the eventual outward channel for recognition and avowal.

structural_cues: 12:77 embeds a judgment inside Joseph and negates its disclosure; 12:90 is organized as an audible question-answer pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies imposed attribution, inward concealment, non-display, and later paired speech; I infer a reversal from others' story to self-authored disclosure. A live alternative is that the earlier concealment is only tactical and does not govern the later naming.

changed_reading.before: The answer resolves a momentary failure to recognize Joseph.
changed_reading.after: The answer culminates a longer discipline of disclosure: Joseph replaces a concealed, imposed account with a timed public avowal of identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers had already perceived the unidentified powerful official as a beneficent actor; the focus self-naming makes their earlier ethical recognition precede and survive their failure of personal recognition.

activation_trace.role: Strength after humiliation gives the official title a latent reversal trajectory beneath the unrecognized identity.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies genuine moral perception despite failed personal recognition.
Beneficent action names the quality they recognize before they know the actor.
The focus maxim repeats beneficent action as the class whose consequence is preserved.
Spoken self-identification finally aligns the previously seen quality with Joseph.

structural_cues: The earlier address and moral assessment occur under an official title; the proper identity is spoken only in 12:90.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier judgment that the official is among beneficent actors and a later maxim about those same actors; I infer a deliberate recognition loop. The maxim may alternatively remain wholly general and not echo their prior assessment.

changed_reading.before: Joseph identifies himself and then states a general maxim about excellent people.
changed_reading.after: His maxim retroactively confirms that the brothers had already recognized his ihsan while failing to recognize him, separating moral sight from facial or social recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding negotiation tries to place one body in another's custody and is refused as wrongful displacement; the focus favor-as-release branch consequently reads as an end to substitutionary detention and exchange.

activation_trace.role: Custody and capture expose the coercive force inside the request to take one person in another's place.
The refusal restricts detention rather than allowing a substitute body to satisfy the claim.
Putting something in the wrong place makes substitution a concrete image of injustice.
Release without compensation supplies a non-exchange reading of divine favor.
Actual kinship replaces the attempted interchangeability of persons with a named relation.

structural_cues: The request to take one brother in another's place is followed by refusal, continued detention, and finally the joint self-identification of Joseph and his brother.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, custody, wrongful placement, and a focus branch of gratuitous release; I infer that favor terminates an exchange logic in which persons stand in for one another. The release branch may instead be only a remote lexical resonance.

changed_reading.before: Divine favor rescued Joseph and his brother from hardship.
changed_reading.after: The favor can also mark liberation from a substitution-and-custody economy: the brothers appear together as persons in a restored relation, not exchangeable bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: A confirmed covenant is followed by admitted neglect of Joseph and then by one brother's refusal to leave; the focus denial of divine wasting answers human forfeiture, while patience acquires the sense of staying bound to a charge.

activation_trace.role: A confirmed covenant supplies the relational obligation against which later conduct is measured.
Neglect and wasting name the brothers' prior failure toward Joseph.
Negated departure supplies a corrective act of remaining in place under obligation.
Surety and continued attachment recast patience as fidelity to a person or charge.
Loss and forfeiture form the exact negative field that divine action reverses.
Recompense for work identifies what divine conservation carries through the failure.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from covenant, through explicit prior neglect, to staying put; the focus then denies that God lets good consequence be lost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human neglect, covenant, corrective staying, and divine non-loss; I infer an anti-waste reversal in which patience repairs fidelity. The focus clause can alternatively be a broad maxim without answering the earlier neglect lexically or causally.

changed_reading.before: God preserves the reward earned by patient righteous people.
changed_reading.after: The non-loss clause answers the story's human wasting: patient fidelity is the practice of not abandoning a bond, and divine action prevents that repaired good from sharing Joseph's earlier forfeiture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father's beautiful patience is grammatically joined to hope that God will gather the dispersed family; when Joseph names himself and his brother before repeating patience, endurance becomes a reunion-producing relation rather than isolated stoicism.

activation_trace.role: Restraint from panic supplies the father's named mode of enduring separation.
Beauty in action qualifies patience by how it is carried, not only by duration.
Joining what was scattered supplies the explicit hoped-for outcome of that patience.
The repeated restraint carries the father's reunion horizon into Joseph's maxim.
The visible brother relation is the first local embodiment of scattered kin being joined.

structural_cues: In 12:83 patience is followed immediately by hope of total gathering; in 12:90 Joseph and his brother are named together before patience is restated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the patience-gathering sequence and the later paired brothers; I infer that reunion is patience's narrative product. The two patience statements may alternatively characterize separate agents without a shared family mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Joseph commends the same individual endurance that his father displayed.
changed_reading.after: Patience is transgenerational and centripetal: it preserves relation across dispersal until separated kin can be gathered again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command not to sever hope is paired with tracking news by the senses and seeking relief; the focus recognition question can therefore be read as the perceptual yield of patient action, not passive waiting.

activation_trace.role: The cutting off of hope supplies the explicitly prohibited failure mode.
Following traces of news turns continued hope into investigative movement.
Relief and rest provide the horizon toward which the search persists.
Active self-guarding keeps despair from closing the search.
Sustained restraint gives the search enough duration to reach recognition.

structural_cues: The command sequence is go, investigate, and do not despair; three ayat later the brothers formulate the recognition question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active search, anti-despair, and subsequent recognition; I infer that patient hope preserves perception until identity can be seen. A live alternative is that the brothers' commercial return, not their search, causes the encounter.

changed_reading.before: Patience means waiting faithfully until God changes the situation.
changed_reading.after: Patience includes hope-governed inquiry: guarding against despair keeps agents moving and sensing until recognition becomes possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Meager goods are carried into a request for full measure and charity, followed by a statement of divine recompense; the focus non-loss of reward converts that commercial scene into an anti-deficit moral account.

activation_trace.role: A small, barely circulating asset supplies the scene's initial material deficit.
Completion without shortfall supplies the requested reversal of deficit.
Measured food gives the reversal a concrete accounting unit.
Charitable property or right converts measured exchange into benefaction.
Matching an act with its consequence links charity to divine recompense.
The denial of forfeiture closes the possibility of moral short measure.
Payment or return for action makes the moral-accounting link explicit.
Beneficent action identifies what enters this non-deficit account.

structural_cues: The focus follows immediately after a material sequence of low tender, full measure, charity, and recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commercial measure, charity, recompense, and then non-lost reward; I infer that the material ledger models a moral economy of no shortfall. The terms may alternatively remain neighboring but independent economic and ethical statements.

changed_reading.before: God never overlooks the moral credit of those who do good.
changed_reading.after: The clause becomes an anti-deficit guarantee: inadequate human means can meet full benefaction, and no unit of enacted good is short-measured in divine recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph first asks whether they know their own deed under ignorance; their next question recognizes the person to whom it was done. Moral knowledge thus opens personal recognition.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower frames the preceding question as an epistemic opening.
An enacted deed makes what must be known moral and historical, not merely visual.
Absence of knowledge supplies the prior state reversed by recognition.
The interrogative saying gives their newly forming knowledge the shape of a hypothesis.
The answer stabilizes that hypothesis as public knowledge.

structural_cues: The question about knowing their deed in 12:89 is answered narratively by their identity question and Joseph's answer in 12:90.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent questions about deed-knowledge and identity; I infer that moral recollection causes recognition. The adjacency may instead mark Joseph's verbal hint as a purely cognitive clue.

changed_reading.before: The brothers infer Joseph's identity from a revealing reference to the past.
changed_reading.after: Recognition is an ethical change of knowing: once the deed done in ignorance becomes knowable, its obscured recipient can become recognizable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph first speaks of favor upon an us, while the brothers immediately recode the event as God's preference of you over us and confess error; the sequence keeps shared restoration and comparative elevation as competing readings.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed benefaction supplies Joseph's non-comparative grammar of grace.
The named brother relation gives the initial us a concrete shared bond.
Preference by choice supplies the brothers' explicitly comparative interpretation.
Missing the right course identifies their acknowledged error inside that comparison.

structural_cues: Joseph's favor-upon-us formulation directly precedes the brothers' preferred-you-over-us formulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shift from shared favor to comparative preference; I infer that Joseph's framing resists a zero-sum account before the brothers reintroduce it. The initial us may refer only to Joseph and his brother without intending any wider correction.

changed_reading.before: Joseph attributes his elevation over his brothers to God's favor.
changed_reading.after: Joseph first frames grace as shared restoration of the two harmed brothers; comparative chosenness is the brothers' next reading, and the text preserves the tension rather than collapsing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus principle is followed immediately by refusal of blame, covering of fault, and mercy whose branch also names kinship; ihsan is therefore enacted as releasing wrongdoers and preserving relation, not merely claimed as reward due.

activation_trace.role: Blame for wrongdoing supplies the sanction that Joseph explicitly declines.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer supplies the requested divine treatment of the wrongdoers.
Tender mercy supplies the affective action replacing reproach.
The kinship branch makes mercy structurally capable of restoring family relation.
Beneficent action supplies the category Joseph immediately performs toward those who harmed him.
Release without compensation anticipates the waiver of reproach.

structural_cues: The maxim about preserved ihsan is followed in the next ayah by no reproach, a prayer for forgiveness, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maxim then merciful response; I infer that Joseph demonstrates the maxim rather than merely describing his own entitlement. The later response can alternatively be a separate act whose sequence does not define the maxim.

changed_reading.before: Joseph explains his favorable outcome as the reward for his own conduct.
changed_reading.after: He immediately turns preserved ihsan outward: its visible reward is the capacity to waive blame, seek protection for offenders, and reopen kinship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The container and stopped-outlet images are materially surprising and should not replace the ordinary sense of patience; they remain anchored in the focus patience and guarding roots and are sharpened by the sequence from held grief to disclosed inward content. Render this only as a pressure-regulation analogy: restraint governs the timing and destination of release rather than requiring permanent silence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of guarding and patience before the spoken assurance.

activation_trace.role: A protective barrier supplies the boundary that keeps pressure from becoming damage.
The sides and upper boundary of a vessel provide the form-distant containment image.
Stopping an outlet after fullness supplies the danger of sealed emotional pressure.
Revealing what was held inside supplies a controlled outlet compatible with endurance.
Voiced speech is the eventual non-destructive release channel.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, patience is regulated containment: guarding supplies a boundary, while rightly directed speech releases pressure without surrendering ethical control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The weight sense of favor is branch-distant and must not be offered as a lexical translation; it remains anchored in the focus favor root and is unusually activated by the immediately preceding little-goods, full-measure, and reward sequence. Render it as a material analogy in which grace supplies a countermeasure to human insufficiency.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Divine favor followed by non-lost recompense.

activation_trace.role: A measured weight lets favor acquire an exploratory quantitative image.
The little offered asset establishes the inadequate side of the countermeasure.
Fullness without deficit supplies the answering excess.
Measured food gives the analogy a concrete scale.
Recompense links the quantitative image back to the focus consequence.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, favor functions as God's countermeasure: meager human means are answered by fullness, and the ensuing reward is not allowed to register a deficit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bone-setting branch of reward is strongly form-distant and should never be presented as the ordinary meaning of recompense; it remains focus-anchored and gains narrative traction when mercy reactivates kinship, endpoints are brought together, sight returns, and the household is gathered. Render it as a contained repair analogy for a family that had persisted in a crookedly healed state.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-loss of reward beside the newly reasserted brother bond.

activation_trace.role: Setting a break healed on an angle supplies the central repair analogy.
The tether image makes the named brother bond the first joint being reset.
Kinship within mercy supplies the tissue of relational repair.
Making two endpoints meet provides a mechanical image of reunion.
Restored ocular seeing embodies repair as recovered perception.
Near affiliation expands repair from one brother bond to the household.
Joining the scattered supplies the repair's final family-scale motion.

changed_reading.before: The reward is a benefit preserved for an excellent individual.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, non-lost reward appears as the resetting of a long-misaligned fracture: brotherhood, perception, and household are brought back into relation.

strongest_changes: The question-answer pair completes a reversal from concealed imposed attribution to timed, self-authored identity.
Divine non-loss answers human neglect and turns patience into covenantal fidelity that gathers rather than abandons.
The full-measure and charity sequence makes reward an anti-deficit moral economy, while the next response enacts ihsan as waived blame and kin mercy.
Recognition becomes ethical and epistemic: the brothers see beneficence before identity and recognize identity only after confronting the deed done in ignorance.
summary.what_was_special: Distinct mechanisms remain live together: public disclosure, unbought release, anti-waste fidelity, reunion, active search, full-measure recompense, noncompetitive grace, and kin mercy. Material readings of pressure, weight, and fracture were retained as explicitly qualified outliers rather than flattened into the main models.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of the focus first-person plural may be limited to Joseph and his brother, so its resistance to the brothers' later comparison remains inferential.
The repeated beneficent-actor language may deliberately echo the brothers' earlier assessment or may be a general maxim.
The container, measured-weight, tether, and bone-setting branches are useful material activators but remain form-distant analogies.
Narrative adjacency supports the proposed causal arrows, but the packet does not state every arrow explicitly.
